sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: 📊 "Structure - Inline artwork": on multi-table pages (a release group's releases, an artist's release groups, …) "🖼️ front-image available" and "∅ NO front-image available" filtered to ZERO rows while showing the right count. A typed "caa-inline-yes"/"caa-inline-no" column filter did the same. The thumbnail's settled state was only ever written to the rendered copy of a row, never to the row the filter actually tests.
On single-table pages the same entries silently missed every row whose thumbnail finished loading AFTER you had sorted or filtered once — the entry counted it, the table did not show it.

Picking the same inline-artwork entry again, or the same "CAA info - Type" entry (e.g. "» image type: Front"), after more artwork had loaded replayed the first pick's row list instead of re-testing: rows whose thumbnail or image metadata arrived in between were left out.

Root cause and fix: a settled thumbnail is now also recorded where the filter can read it (keyed by row and column, like the per-cell expand state), and the dropdown's counts read the same record, so a count and the rows it filters to cannot disagree. When artwork arrives late, only the cached filter results that can read artwork are dropped — typing an ordinary filter while artwork is still loading keeps its cache.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: CLAUDE.md: CAA/EAA section records why inline-art presence is matched through one resolver and not the cell's span, and the three guards not to undo. DEBUG-NOTES.md: dated root-cause entry with the fixture results and mutation outcomes. tests/MEASUREMENTS.org: the per-settle master-row lookup cost that ruled out mirroring the span, and the per-row cost the fix does add.
